summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 1, 2026, attaching a Hong Kong Stock Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return reporting a share repurchase. On June 1, 2026, the issuer repurchased 1,915,100 ordinary shares at HKD 20.8757 per share, representing ~0.204% of pre-event issued shares, held as treasury shares. The buyback was board-authorized and complies with HK listing rules. The filing is a routine disclosure under HK Main Board Rule 13.25A, not a tender offer or special distribution. The buyback reduces float but does not alter total shares outstanding (972,508,041). Watch for continued repurchase activity and impact on liquidity.
